provenance: Assistant visual review explicitly authorized by project owner; not human-reviewed. Order was assigned from the source page image and document reading flow, without using PP-StructureV3, MinerU, or Docling output order.

matching.metric: Pairwise block-order accuracy over matched blocks with distinct predicted order; pairs sharing one predicted block index are excluded and counted separately.
